cards.lessonTitle: Llama 4: dense-to-sparse family design
cards.implementationNote: Executable constituent reference checks: top1_scaled_route, position, chunk. No runnable full-family preset or published checkpoint compatibility; source-specific composition, dimensions, trained weights, tokenizer, post-training and optimized kernels remain separate porting work. The position check uses Scout's 48 layers with a NoPE layer every fourth; the other two checks use toy sizes (16 experts, chunk 4).
definingMechanisms: Scout text path: 16 routed experts with top-1 routing plus a shared expert; the sigmoid of the selected router logit is the gate and is not renormalised (not DeepSeek's normalised sigmoid with selection bias)
iRoPE layout: chunked attention (chunk 8192, not a sliding window) with RoPE on three of every four layers and a global NoPE layer every fourth (48 layers for Scout)
Attention and multimodal versus text-only boundaries require source audit
